title: Strain against load, with one reading from a saturated amplifier
intro: A bracket was loaded from 2 to 10 kN and once at 25 kN, and the strain (µε) read from a gauge. At 25 kN the amplifier had reached the top of its range, so that reading is too low. The point sits far from the other x values (leverage 0.86) and pulls the line towards itself: its Cook's distance is 24.
